title: The sprint skill's plan step asks for each planted check to run in the landing's check environment against a prototype of the fix
goal: the plan step of skills/sprint/SKILL.md says a planted check that reads query-log, spool or workspace state is run once through bl_base.run_check (its isolated CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA home) against a prototype of the fix before the start gate

run:
import os, re, shlex, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
R = os.getcwd()
text = open("skills/sprint/SKILL.md", encoding="utf-8").read()
m = re.search(r"\n## plan.*?\n## start", text, re.S)
plan = m.group(0) if m else ""
bad = []
if "run_check" not in plan:
    bad.append("the plan step does not name bl_base.run_check")
cmds = [c for c in re.findall(r"`([^`\n]+)`", plan) if re.search(r"backlog\.py\s+--root\s+\S+\s+precheck\s+SP\b", c)]
if not cmds:
    bad.append("the plan step gives no backlog.py --root PROTOTYPE precheck SP command")
else:
    T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    env = dict(os.environ, KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), "c.sqlite"))
    def sh(*a): return subprocess.run(a, cwd=T, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
    g = lambda *a: sh("git", "-c", "user.email=a@b", "-c", "user.name=n", *a)
    g("init", "-q", "."); g("commit", "-q", "--allow-empty", "-m", "init")
    shutil.copy(R + "/backlog.json", T); os.makedirs(T + "/kb/_self/backlog")
    sp = re.search(r"SP-\w+", sh(sys.executable, R + "/_tools/backlog.py", "--root", T, "new", "sprint", "--title", "S", "--goal", "g").stdout).group(0)
    argv = shlex.split(cmds[0].replace("${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}", R))
    at = argv.index("--root")
    argv[at + 1] = T
    r = sh(*[sp if a == "SP" else a for a in argv])
    if r.returncode != 0:
        bad.append("the precheck command of the plan step exits %d: %s" % (r.returncode, (r.stdout + r.stderr)[-160:]))
print("; ".join(bad) or "ok")
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

notes: Retrospective of SP-hja7yu5k: the span story's check 1 passed from a shell and failed twice at the landing (step checks) because the landing runs checks with an empty CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA home, where kbmon --events printed the cursor 1.0.N.0 and the redaction rewrote it to 192.0.2.10 (a real bug, fixed in the sprint). Run through bl_base.run_check, the check shows it at plan time. The check reads the plan section for the word; a planned item adds the command form. Plan 2026-10-24: premise runs on base (exit 1: the plan section has no run_check and no command). The old check read only the word run_check in the plan section; it passed on a skill text whose rule gives no command. Rewritten as the plan rule for a rule that tells an agent to run a command: the plan section must name run_check and give the command form, which the check runs on a planted sprint (exit 0). Command form for the worker to write into plan step 6, as one backtick span: python3 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/_tools/backlog.py --root PROTOTYPE precheck SP, run from a worktree of the base with a prototype of the fix applied: precheck runs each committed item check through bl_base.run_check, the runner of the landing (isolated CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA home, colourless env), so a check that reads query-log, spool or workspace state shows there what the landing will see. Evidence: SP-hja7yu5k check 1 passed from a shell and failed twice at the landing. Docs mapped to the skill (AGENTS.md has a 4 KB cap and is not touched): backlog.md, maintaining.md read, Self-Reviewed if still correct.
